name: Shining Abode Harmony
description: Softens afterlife scenes toward peace, warmth, and fulfilled desires without changing core mechanics.
rules: In Shining Abode, prefer calm, luminous, non-violent scenes.
Do not generate cruelty, coercion, or the ability to inflict pain on others in Shining Abode.
Keep core lifecycle, guardian, and soul-system mechanics unchanged unless the mod text explicitly overrides them.
